item.title: Leavenworth in the dark as Chelan County, WA reports 11,000 power outages
item.description: Nearly 11,000 people in Chelan County are without power and the entire city of Leavenworth is currently in the dark.

item.title: Summit at Snoqualmie ski slopes bare after WA's atmospheric river storms
item.description: Hopes for an early ski season at The Summit at Snoqualmie have taken a hit after this week’s atmospheric rivers washed away much of the snow that had started to accumulate.

item.title: LIVE UPDATES: Evacuations, major river flooding across western WA
item.description: Severe flooding is expected across western Washington as rivers hit record levels, leading to widespread evacuations and road closures.

item.title: WA rivers hit record levels, highest in 10 years
item.description: An atmospheric river caused record flooding in Western Washington, with several rivers reaching historic levels.

item.title: Seattle Seahawks release Cam Akers, Shaquill Griffin
item.description: The Seattle Seahawks made a pair of roster moves on Thursday, releasing veteran running back Cam Akers and cornerback Shaquill Griffin.

item.title: KATSEYE brings high-energy show to Seattle's WAMU Theater
item.description: The six-member group KATSEYE debuted last summer with the appropriately titled track, “Debut,” and since then they have been taking on the world.

item.title: Mystic Story’s Billlie and ARrC team up for one of K-Pop’s rarest collabs
item.description: K-pop companies don't usually give fans official coed crossovers, so when MYSTIC STORY groups ARrC and Billlie teamed up for “WoW (Way of Winning),” both of the group’s fans tuned in.

item.title: Seattle weather: Drier skies Friday, some rivers remain above flood stage
item.description: High river levels continue after the heaviest showers came to an end Thursday, with a Flash Flood Watch still in effect for the Skagit River.

item.title: Double murder investigation underway on Herron Island in Pierce County, WA
item.description: Pierce County deputies are investigating a double murder on Herron Island after a man and woman were found dead inside a home while conducting a welfare check.

item.title: WA floodwaters leaves some residents trapped near Skykomish River
item.description: The Skykomish River may have been receding by Thursday afternoon, but it still packed a punch throughout the day.
